name: Fractera Reverse Engineering
shortDescription: The node's reverse engineering tool: it is meant to study how a finished site or app works and report it in the product's own words, so an element can plan its own version.
longDescription:
A built-in element that the node turns on only for a task and off right after it, because the work is heavy and rare. An element that wants to build something like an existing product asks the node; the node turns this element on, its agent studies the product in a browser without a window and writes a report: roles, scenarios, entities, rules, pages and where the data comes from. The product quiz turns the report into stages of development. It studies how a product works; it does not copy the product's code, texts, images, design or data.

Today only the body exists: the element is installed, built and turned off. The browser, the analysis and the report come in the next steps.
accepts: Nothing yet: the element is turned off by default, and the node turns it on for one reverse engineering task.
